No Swift SDK/JNI/UIKit/device execution. Java source.browser callbacks model a Host wire boundary, never actual webpage rendering or successful UIKit ACK. Real Preview/Host/Presenter/WK integration and Native definition are owned by companion Swift stage.

Finite WebJS support only; remaining request functions, direct HTTP get/head/post overloads, file/download/crypto/general WebView, showBrowser, sheet configuration UI and verification-flight remain typed unsupported.

Page/request/child controls are embedding bounds:8pages/session,32concurrent children/page,4096requests/page,30s child timeout,4MiB child String result. Existing cache limits and HTTP authority stay unchanged.

Source revision/actual page binding validation resides in the existing Swift Host owner integration. Parent effect receipt is not retroactively rewritten after producer terminal; later nonawait page facts belong to its page lifetime.
implementation: Page scope lives in the existing RuntimeSession and is minted only by explicit login browser admission. Parent normal completion retains a nonawait page; explicit cancellation/session/page close seals and drains it. No new VM, HTTP transport, credential owner or backing cache.

Exact JS_INJECTION2 template aliases/request/callback-cache discipline; explicit GET empty still receives injection. POST replaces prepared HTML once without reinjection; present empty has no WebJS bridge. Awaittrue reuses present prepared body; false retains existing DOM/URL reply.

One retained page AnalyzeRule with null Book/Chapter. Cancellable per-page Mutex serializes parser state; child runs on a distinct existing worker context, rejecting synchronous Rhino reentry. Production platform and persistence dynamically route to that child RuntimeTask while retaining same session HTTP/Cookie/cache owner.

Synchronous finite Java/cache and request(run/three already implemented helpers) return typed String/null/list/void. Async run null stringifies to literal null; direct cache missing remains true null; result lives only in existing RuleCache memory until JS2 consume/delete.

Single deadline timer handler seals and cancels only. Worker explicit close sends native cancellation then awaits issued child completion. Cancelled producer worker drains before terminal effect snapshot, including accepted ACK arriving after cancellation; finally also closes a late-cancelled producer. Bounded child facts merge into the still registered parent; a completed parent terminal is immutable.
ownership: Page lifetime retains its existing RuntimeSession after a nonawait producer returns. Close, producer cancellation and source edits seal/cancel/drain the actual owned children. Same indexed BookSourceStore verifies initial presence and later one-source revisions; no new persistent store or index.
